what: On open, N photos unfold from a single point along a centered ∞ orbit (Bernoulli lemniscate — horizontal panel width/2.5, vertical 1.2× that) and spin (the last 20% of the 2s linear orbit progress runs 2s power1.out, photos scale .5→1 over .25s at .05s intervals). When finished, the last photo stops exactly at center, and from that spot the stage (video or large photo) expands from a 200rem rounded rectangle (20rem corners, phone 50rem · 5px) to fill the panel with 0 corners in 2s expo.inOut. The photo group shrinks to 0× in the same 2s while rewinding the orbit to 80%. Meanwhile the inner video keeps its cover ratio to match the rectangle. .75s after the expansion starts it fires fx:revealed (hook the header and title entrances onto it)

options.open: Unfold duration (sec), default 2 — shorten for screens opened often, like an app
options.size: Initial square side (px), default board width×200/1512 (width 768 or less ×50/375)
options.radius: Initial corner (px), default panel width×20/1512 (5 at width 768 or less)

note: The original is anime.js v4 — out(2) is carried over as power1.out, inOutExpo as expo.inOut. The original orbit formula x = cx + S cos a/(1+sin²a), y = cy + 1.2S cos a sin a/(1+sin²a), a = (progress×2π + i/N×2π + π/2)×spread
